top_signals.title: IMF Warns Middle East War Could Derail Global Economic Growth
top_signals.summary: The energy crisis sparked by the war in the Middle East remains the biggest risk for the global economy, but investment in artificial intelligence provides grounds for optimism, the International Monetary Fund has said, expecting global growth of 3.4% next year. “The global economy has been resilient, but that resilience is reaching its limits, so we need to move from just coping to rebuilding,” the institution’s chief economist, Silvana Tenreyro, told the media, as quoted by Reuters. “We need to restore fiscal space. top_signals.title: Systems Like Supply Chains are Being ‘Weaponized’: Modi
top_signals.summary:
Indian PM Narendra Modi warned that the interconnected systems that once united the world like supply chains, trade and tech have become instruments of coercion.

He said at the Bloomberg New Economy Forum that India stands apart with a different approach. (Source: Bloomberg)

top_signals.title: BofA Poll Shows Investors Most Exposed to Tech Stocks Since 2020
top_signals.summary: Global investors chasing the AI-powered equity rally are the most exposed to technology stocks since the rebound from the Covid pandemic six years ago, according to a poll by Bank of America Corp.

top_signals.title: (USD:UGX) Uganda Shilling Turns Worst Currency as Investors Sour on Local Debt
top_signals.summary: Uganda’s shilling slid to a new 33-year low on Tuesday, as foreign investors sold local bonds and authorities held back from supporting the currency.
